How ALFRED helps

Questions, answered.

The things project managers and installers ask us most. Anything else, just email the project.

How do I get a quote?

Email your project to projects@americangraphiccontractors.com the way you already have it: drawings or mockups, photos, a site list or a quick note. ALFRED reads it first and checks it against our 99 Questions, then a project manager comes back to you with what is clear, what is still missing and anything that affects price, such as access, removals or after-hours work. Once those points are answered, you get a quote for the scope as confirmed. For a repeat program, ALFRED matches it to your past jobs, including any issues on site, so the quote starts from what we already know.

What should I send with a request?

Whatever you already have is a good start. The details that make a quote accurate are: site addresses and an on-site contact; graphic sizes and quantities, or the mockups and drawings that show them; the material and laminate if the graphics are already printed; the surfaces they go on; whether anything old has to come off first; and your target dates and preferred work window. If a detail is missing, we ask before we quote, not on install day.

Do you print the graphics?

No. AGC is an installation partner, not a printer. You or your print partner produce the graphics and ship them to the site or to our crew; we receive them, install them to your specifications and document every location. Because we are not selling print, our advice on materials, sizes and site conditions is about what installs well, and we are glad to work alongside your existing print producer.

Can you quote day and after-hours work?

Yes. On request we price a daytime window (8 am to 5 pm) and an after-hours window (5 pm to 11 pm) side by side, so you can choose per location. After hours often suits busy downtown sites, malls and stores that can’t have crews on the floor while they’re open; daytime is usually simplest where the space is closed or your own. Weekend work can be scheduled too, and in some locations we offer 24-hour service.

Do you offer site surveys?

Yes. Before anything is printed or quoted, we can visit each location to measure every surface, photograph it and note its condition: paint, texture, existing films or graphics, obstructions and access. You get the measurements and photos to build artwork from, so files are sized right the first time. For programs, surveys can be scheduled across many locations at once, and a survey isn’t always needed if you already have accurate drawings.

What are the 99 Questions?

They are the questions our project managers ask before every quote, gathered into one checklist: scope, site conditions, surfaces, materials, access, permits, timing and close-out. We use them to catch the details that cause delays and surprise costs later. They are available as a free eBook, so your own team, from sales and design to project management, can use the same checklist when briefing any install.

Get the free eBook
Where do you install?

Across the United States and Canada. AGC has rated installers in 21 U.S. states and 9 Canadian provinces and has installed at more than 950 locations, from a single storefront to programs spanning hundreds of sites. Crews are matched to each job by location and skill, so the work is done locally to one AGC standard.

Can you work after hours?

Yes. We schedule around your business so stores, branches and offices keep running: daytime, after hours, overnight or weekends, with 24-hour service in some locations. Tell us your opening hours and any quiet periods when you send the project, and we plan the work window, crew size and visit order around them. Where a site has its own rules, such as mall access times or venue check-in, they go into the schedule before the crew is booked.

Do you remove old graphics?

Yes. Removals are part of everyday work for our crews: expired campaign vinyl, old signage and letters, window film, wall graphics and retail fixtures. Crews clear adhesive residue and can patch and paint old fastener holes, so the surface is clean and ready for the next install. If old graphics need to come down before new ones go up, include it in the request so it is quoted and scheduled as one visit.

What about permits, lifts and access?

We confirm site logistics before a crew is booked: the on-site contact, check-in or badge rules, loading and parking, and any permits, for example when work near a street might need a closure. For work at height we confirm lift needs and safe tie-off points. If the site has rules of its own, like mall access windows or venue badges, they go into the job details so the crew arrives prepared.

Does the surface matter?

A lot. Freshly painted walls need time to cure before vinyl bonds properly, textured or uneven surfaces need the right material and technique, and existing window films change how new film sits on the glass. That is why we ask what the surface is, and when walls were last painted, before install day. If a surface isn’t ready, we would rather tell you before the crew arrives than after.

What safety gear do your crews use?

Crews wear PPE suited to the job, and it is standard AGC policy whenever we work with rigid signage. For work at height we confirm lifts and tie-off points in advance. If your site has its own safety rules or induction, tell us when you book and the crew will follow them.

Can you run a national rollout?

Yes. One AGC point of contact plans the whole program with you, from the first site survey to the final close-out. Every request is checked against our 99 Questions, crews are matched to each location by area, skill set and project type, and every detail is confirmed before work starts. Each site is installed to your brand standards and closed out with end-of-day reports and photos, so a program of hundreds of stores is handled the same way as one.

What do I get after the install?

End-of-day reports with photos for every location, so you can see what was installed and how it looks without visiting. Programs also get close-out documentation for each site, all tracked in Client Flow, where you can check status, photos and files at any time. Installers record any issues, such as damaged graphics, in their close-out notes, so nothing gets missed.

What is Client Flow?

Client Flow is your project portal. For every location it shows status and scope, files, the install schedule, a map of your sites, shipping and tracking, pricing and approvals, install photos and the weather around the install date. Updates appear as work happens, so your team and AGC always look at the same information.

Who is ALFRED?

ALFRED (Agentic Liaison for Flow, Recursive Execution & Delivery) is AGC’s AI chief of staff. He reads every incoming request, assigns the work to the right specialized AI agents, checks it against our 99 Questions to flag anything missing, and makes sure every email, PO and photo lands on the right project. Anything that needs a decision goes to people: our project managers review and approve what he does.

How do I get into my portal?

Tap My Portal at the top of the page and enter the email address AGC has on file for you; that email is what connects you to your client or installer portal. If you are new or your email has changed, use Request access in the same window, or call 1 (877) 395-7435 and we will set you up.

How do I pay an invoice?

Tap the cart button in the header (or Make a Payment below) to open the payment options: pay by card in USD or CAD, or by ACH / EFT bank transfer with no fees. For questions about an invoice, email accounting@americangraphiccontractors.com or call 1 (877) 395-7435.

Make a Payment
How do installers work with AGC?

Email hello@americangraphiccontractors.com with your company name, the cities and regions you cover, the types of work you do (for example window film, wall graphics, signage or fixtures) and equipment such as lifts. Jobs you are assigned come with files, scope, schedule and site details in Field Flow, and you close each job out there with photos and notes.

What is Field Flow?

Field Flow is the installer app. Each job has its files, scope, schedule, a map, shipping and tracking, the local weather forecast and a close-out step in one place. Installers submit close-out photos and notes about what was completed and any issues, which feed straight into the client’s reports.

What does AGC-rated mean?

It is an installer who has completed work for AGC and been rated on it. Along with location and skill set, ratings help us match the right crew to each job. More than 580 installers carry an AGC rating today.

Do you offer training?

Yes. The free 99 Questions eBook walks through project intake from the first brief, and the Installer Tool Finder on this site suggests the right tools for a job. You can also follow AGC University, our free YouTube channel.

Watch AGC University
Which tools do your crews recommend?

The Installer Tool Finder on this site lists the tools our crews recommend: squeegees and buffers, knives and cutters, heat guns, ladders and platforms, wrap tools, removal tools, safety gear and cleaning supplies. Search or browse by category, or describe the job and it builds a kit for you. Product links go to Amazon.

One site or one hundred. Let’s get it done right.

No forms. Email your project the way you already have it: drawings, photos, a site list or a quick note. A project manager picks it up from there and comes back to you with what’s clear and what’s still needed.

Mini Series Retail Launch

A dimensional retail rollout

AGC partnered with TOB Inc. to support a multi-location retail display rollout inspired by a hit streaming mini series, installed across telecom retail stores throughout Western Canada.

PartnerTOB Inc.
StoresTelecom retail
RegionWestern Canada
BuildLayered 3D displays

The goal was a bold, dimensional in-store experience that captured the look and energy of the series, while staying consistent, durable and retail-ready at scale.

Built in 3D, not flat

Each installation was a layered 3D display rather than a flat graphic. Dimensional components, sculpted details and raised elements were assembled on site to create depth and visual impact.

Themed bicycle props extended the display into the customer space, creating an interactive, photo-friendly moment without disrupting store flow.

Installed across Western Canada

AGC managed every install through its experienced retail installer network. Store layouts varied by location, so each display took careful planning and on-site adaptability to go in safely and consistently.

Precise sequencing, clean finishes and attention to detail kept the intended effect the same in every store.

The result

A high-impact retail activation that turned everyday telecom stores into immersive brand moments tied to a globally recognized entertainment property.

It shows how AGC runs complex, multi-location retail installs with custom 3D elements and interactive features, with consistency and precision.

How ALFRED works

Faster answers

How ALFRED gets you answers sooner.

  • Spots every new request within minutes, whether it’s an email, drawings, photos or a site list, and opens the job with every location on your order.
  • Checks it against our 99 Questions and asks only what is still missing, so one reply covers it.
  • Builds your estimate from our rate card and your past jobs, ready for your project manager to review and send.
  • Follows up on open quotes and flags any email that has waited a full day for an answer.

Fewer surprises

How ALFRED takes the surprises out of install day.

  • Matches each location with a vetted local installer whose insurance covers the install date.
  • Checks the local rules for every state and province: licences, permits, electrical, work at height and language.
  • Checks store hours and holidays against every booking, and watches the forecast for outdoor installs.
  • Puts the job in the installer’s calendar and sends a reminder the day before, with files and photo links.

Nothing slips

How ALFRED keeps every detail attached to the right job.

  • Matches every email, text, PO and file to the right project and location, and flags anything that looks misplaced.
  • Reads your PO into the job and checks it against the estimate before anything is scheduled.
  • Sends tracking numbers to the right installer and flags any install still missing tracking three business days out.
  • A senior project manager agent watches every job start to finish and raises risks before they become problems.

Total clarity

How ALFRED keeps you in the picture, start to finish.

  • Every photo batch is checked against your layouts and scope, and anything that doesn’t match gets a retake request.
  • A safety check before work starts and a store manager sign-off at the end of every visit.
  • Installer photos from email, text or cloud links are filed to the right location automatically.
  • People stay in charge: ALFRED drafts, our project managers approve, and nothing is sent without a human.
Powered by AI. Approved by people.

Privacy Policy

Effective November 16, 2026

In short: we collect only what we need to run your projects, we never sell your personal information, and you can ask us to see, correct or delete it at any time.

American Graphic Contractors (“AGC”, “we”, “us”) installs commercial graphics across the United States and Canada.

This policy explains how we handle personal information when you use our website, chat with ALFRED, use the Client Flow or Field Flow portals, or contact us by email or phone.

We collect what you choose to send us, such as:

  • Contact details: name, company, job title, email address and phone number.
  • Project details: site addresses, on-site contacts, drawings, files, photos, schedules and purchase orders.
  • For installation partners: business details, service areas, skills, insurance documents and the tax and payment details we need to pay you.

When you visit our website, our hosting and analytics providers receive standard technical information: your IP address and approximate location, browser and device type, the pages you view, how you arrived and when.

We use this to keep the website working, secure and easy to use, and to understand which pages are helpful.

ALFRED answers general questions about AGC using public information only. Your conversation runs in your browser, is not saved, and starts fresh on every visit.

If you rate an answer with a thumbs up or down, we receive the rating together with your question, the answer, the page and the language, so we can improve ALFRED. Please don’t type personal or confidential details into the chat.

To make the website easier to use, a few settings stay in your own browser: your language choice, the email you last used to open your portal, your 99 Questions selections and some display preferences.

They are not sent to us, and you can remove them at any time by clearing your browser’s site data.

  • To quote, plan, schedule, install and document your projects.
  • To match each job with a qualified installation partner and give them what they need to do the work.
  • To communicate with you, answer questions and provide support.
  • To invoice, take payments and pay installation partners.
  • To improve our website, our portals and ALFRED, and to keep them secure.
  • To meet legal, tax and insurance requirements.

We use automated tools, including artificial intelligence, to help our team organize requests, draft replies, schedule work and check completed installs against your specifications.

Powered by AI, approved by people: decisions that matter, such as pricing, approvals and assignments, are made or reviewed by a person.

We share personal information only as needed:

  • With installation partners, who receive the site, contact and job details needed to complete the work.
  • With clients, who receive installer names, photos and reports for their own jobs.

We do not sell your personal information.

  • With service providers that host, store, process or deliver information for us, such as website hosting, email, databases, payment processing, analytics and AI services. They may use it only to provide those services.
  • When required by law, to protect rights and safety, or as part of a business transfer.

Card payments are processed securely by Stripe. We receive confirmation of your payment, but not your full card number.

Bank transfer details are exchanged by email on request and are used only to send or receive payments.

Our website and its hosting provider use cookies and similar technologies that the site needs to work. We also use Google Analytics to understand how the site is used, and Google advertising tags to measure how our ads perform.

You can block or delete cookies in your browser settings, manage ad personalization in your Google account’s ad settings, and opt out of Google Analytics with Google’s browser add-on. Some parts of the website may not work without cookies.

Some content comes from other companies, which receive basic technical information from your browser when it loads: images and fonts, satellite imagery for the globe, videos played from YouTube in privacy-enhanced mode, and Google reviews.

Links to Amazon, Stripe, Facebook, Instagram, YouTube and Google Maps take you to their own sites, where their privacy policies apply. Product links to Amazon may earn AGC a commission.

We and our service providers store information in the United States and Canada, and it may be processed in other countries where those providers operate.

We keep personal information only as long as we need it for the purposes above, including project records we must keep for legal, tax and insurance reasons. After that we delete it or make it anonymous.

We protect information with safeguards suited to its sensitivity, including encrypted connections, access limited to people who need it, and secure sign-in for our portals.

No method of sending or storing information online is completely secure. If a breach affects your information, we will notify you and the authorities as the law requires.

Depending on where you live, including under Canadian privacy laws and U.S. state privacy laws, you may ask us to:

  • See the personal information we hold about you and get a copy.
  • Correct information that is wrong or incomplete.
  • Delete your information, or withdraw your consent where we rely on it.
  • Stop marketing emails, using the unsubscribe link or by contacting us.

We will confirm your identity before acting, respond within the time the law allows, and never treat you differently for using your rights. If you are not satisfied, you can ask us to reconsider or contact your privacy regulator.

Our services are for businesses and are not directed to children. We do not knowingly collect personal information from anyone under 16. If you believe a child has sent us information, contact us and we will delete it.

We may update this policy as our services change. We will post the new version here with its effective date, and tell you directly about important changes.

For privacy questions or requests, contact AGC’s privacy contact:

  • Email: hello@americangraphiccontractors.com
  • Phone: 1 (877) 395-7435
  • Mail: American Graphic Contractors, 30 N Gould St Ste R, Sheridan, WY 82801, USA
